primitives.name: Claim Verification Status Operator
primitives.verbatim_quote: Statuses: CONFIRMED (2+ independent sources or 1 official) / SINGLE (one source) / UNVERIFIED / OVERTURNED (later reporting reversed it) / STALE (source predates final reports).
primitives.assumptions: Claims are binary events with discrete verification states; status probabilities are time-invariant.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When \( P(S = \text{UNVERIFIED}) > 0.5 \), system enters exploratory mode.

layer2.mapping: GSI's belief propagation maps to a Markov chain over status space; GSE's action selection uses status-weighted utility functions.
layer2.telemetry: Source count and temporal consistency metrics.
